description: Answer a ticket's customer. channel email (Pro or higher) sends an email, and the customer's answer comes back into the ticket. channel chat shows the message in the website chat, only for tickets from the widget. The customer gets it, so get the user's agreement first.

also_chat.description: email channel: also show the reply in the website chat (default true).

message.description: The full reply, as the customer will read it.

resolve.description: Mark the ticket resolved after sending (default false).

ticket_number.description: The ticket number, for example TKT-00042.

name: reply_to_ticket
title: Reply to a support ticket
